name: Resource Node
description: A rock, tree or fishing spot players gather from: press E (or the phone's action button), stay beside it while the bar fills, and what it gives lands in their hand. It runs out after a few uses and shows when it comes back. The Multiplayer Server decides. Works with: Pickup Item, Work Station.

changelog.notes: An empty node stays in place with a floating countdown ("Back in 0:24") instead of vanishing; set whenEmpty to "hide" for the old behaviour. The countdown words are params, for the scene's language.

Initial release: gather by staying beside the node while a bar fills, the item lands in the player's hand through Pickup Item's carry, a number of uses before it runs out, a respawn timer shown as a floating countdown (or hiding the node), one gatherer at a time decided by the Multiplayer Server, and script events for every gather.
